dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing initiated from the mid-body region and progressing symmetrically toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity aligns with a dark-grey to slate-grey baseline, characteristic of a non-mature individual.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-frequency distribution of diffuse, lighter-grey clusters (mottling) across the entire visible dorsal surface, particularly concentrated in the mid-to-posterior regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes with low-contrast transitions between darker pigmented areas and lighter mottled regions.
